class.name: NNBTNodeReference
class.brief_description: Delegates execution to another behaviour tree node anywhere in the scene.
class.description: Ticks [member node_reference] in place, letting you reuse shared subtrees or swap behaviour branches dynamically at runtime. For example, an item or smart object can carry its own behaviour subtree, and an AI can point an [NNBTNodeReference] at it when picking up or interacting with the item. Multiple references can safely share the same target subtree; cycles are rejected.

members.member: Target [NNBTNodes] subtree to tick. Returns [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE] if unset or disabled. Assignments that would create a cycle are rejected.
